rationale: Lydia bridges developer experience and AI tooling at Anthropic's Claude Code team, while Artem optimizes inference performance and open-source LLMs at Osmosis AI — both are deeply invested in making frontier models faster and more accessible to developers. Lydia's track record turning complex technical concepts into visual, in-depth educational content combined with Artem's hands-on builder background in real-time VLM inference and model acceleration creates a natural complement: her ability to communicate DX strategy could amplify adoption of the efficient inference work he's shipping.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Artem Yatsenko — you're both working to make cutting-edge AI tools more accessible; Lydia through developer experience at Anthropic and Artem through efficient inference optimization at Osmosis AI.
